description: This header file defines the interface for the NotificationHandler class, which manages notifications, registration of callbacks, and notification queue accessed via static methods. It includes references to external headers and declares the class with private static members, constructors, destructors, and notification push methods.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to manage and dispatch notifications, register callbacks, and maintain a notification queue. It encapsulates static members for global access and manages different types of notification push methods.

methods.name: NotificationHandler
methods.description: Constructor (private), initializes an instance of NotificationHandler.

methods.name: ~NotificationHandler
methods.description: Destructor (private), handles cleanup for the NotificationHandler instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NotificationHandler.

methods.name: GetNotificationQueue
methods.description: Provides access to the static notification queue for posting notifications.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked on notification updates.

methods.name: pushValueChangeNotification
methods.description: Pushes a notification indicating a value has changed, based on event data.

methods.name: pushKeyValueNotification
methods.description: Pushes a key-value notification to the destination specified.

methods.name: push_device_mgmt_notifications
methods.description: Pushes device management related notifications with parameters like delay, startTime, download status, etc.

methods.name: push_device_deepsleep_notifications
methods.description: Pushes deepsleep related notifications with status and event time.
